entities.summary: Cristina Torrens Valero is a former professional female tennis player from Spain. She won two singles and two doubles titles on the WTA Tour. Cristina reached her career-high singles ranking of world No. 27 on 4 March 2002. Cristina Torrens Valero was a athletes & competitors from Pamplona (b. 1974-09-12, Pamplona).
